messages:
maria: Quick proposal  run a 3-part mini-series in Sept: Week 1: "Inference TCO & Benchmarks"; Week 2: "Fallbacks & Rollouts"; Week 3: "Optimization Workshop: batching, caching, quantization". Series angle = teachable, short, drives product trials. Thoughts? :sparkles:
alex: Love it. Short episodes (30m each) will be easier for signups. Keeps momentum and multiple touchpoints for lead routing.
sam: Creative can make a unified series hero + 3 episode variants. Need final titles and hero stat by 8/10 to hit promo windows.
priya: I can lead the Optimization Workshop and prepare a reproducible repo for attendees. Need 20-min hands-on + 10-min Q&A format.
ben: Ops will own the Fallbacks episode with an anonymized incident case study + checklist. Can we promise a checklist takeaway?
nina: I'll do the TCO episode with bench highlights and a short customer vignette. Will need access to the benchmark slides and sanitized numbers.
lee: Logistics: propose Wed evenings to capture EMEA + US overlap. Studio windows: 2026-09-02, 09, 16. calendar-bot: Tentative series slots added -> https://cal.example.com/series/1972468000 :calendar: 
maria: Format proposal per episode: 00:00-00:03 - Intro + poll; 00:03-00:18 - Main content (15m); 00:18-00:25 - Demo/case (7m); 00:25-00:30 - Q&A + CTA. Keep it 30m sharp so we can run 3 weeks straight.
alex: For demos, pre-record heavy data fetches and keep a 2-minute live toggle. Always have a pre-recorded fallback clip.
sam: Promo plan: 2-week drip per episode: Save the Date, Episode 1 live, Episode reminder. Short social clips (15s) + 30s highlight reel after each episode.
emily: Lead routing: add form checkboxes: "Interested in Dedicated/Private", "Interested in Benchmark review", and "Request follow-up demo". Routing rules: benchmark/interested+spend>=10k -> Sales A; demo=yes -> Solutions; Dedicated checkbox -> PM-led pilot queue.
maria: Also want to experiment with a short messaging A/B across episodes: technical vs outcomes-led. We'll measure reg->attendee->SQL funnel. Jordan? (tag) can you add GA + CRM events?
priya: Rehearsals: tech dry run (15m) 2 days before each episode, full run-through 1 day before. I can make the repo and a short 'what to install' doc for workshop attendees.
ben: I'll prepare the ops checklist slide (3 bullets) and the incident timeline screenshot (redacted). Request SRE redaction by 8/20.
nina: Abstracts: I'll draft 75-word episode blurbs + 3 takeaways for each episode. Deadline: 8/12 so Sam can start creative.
lee: Registration flow: series landing with episode-specific CTAs and per-episode RSVP. We can collect per-episode interest checkboxes. Booked studio tentatively for 2026-09-09 10:00 PT for Episode 1 final recording. calendar-bot: Episode 1 recording -> https://cal.example.com/event/1972468000/ep1
sam: Creative deadlines: hero + three thumbnails by 8/15; promo clips by 8/22; post-event reels within 48h. Also need speaker headshots + bios by 8/12.
emily: Sales integration: tag registrants with episode interest and form fields. Also add a custom field "current inference spend" (optional) so Sales can prioritize.
alex: Measurement plan: track header CTR, reg conversion, attendance rate, demo requests. We'll do a 3-week nurture for non-attendees.
maria: Run-of-show (series-level) and sticky checklist to include: speaker abstracts, slide deck template, prerecorded fallback clips, studio booking, rehearsal invites, reg page, tracking spec, lead routing map. I'll own collating the checklist doc.
ben: Ops note: include a 1-slide "playbook" for customer engineers: circuit-breakers, rollout windows, KV cache checks  3 bullets.
priya: Workshop notes: repo will include a minimal evaluator, routing stub, and a sample prompt set. I'll aim for a 20-minute guided lab that attendees can complete in-session.
nina: I'll coordinate with Bench team to pull sanitized graphs and the hero stat for episode 1. Need access by 8/7.
sam: Can we run a small beta promo to current customers first (email) to seed high-intent registrants? Creative can spin a customer-only CTA frame.
emily: Good idea. We'll do a customer email 10 days before Episode 1 and tag responses.
lee: Confirmed: studio tentatively reserved for 09-09; will lock on 8/20 after we confirm abstracts. calendar-bot: Studio hold placed; will confirm when assets are in.
maria: Action items recap: Nina -> episode blurbs + hero stat by 8/12; Priya -> repo + workshop doc by 8/20; Ben -> ops checklist + redacted incident by 8/20; Sam -> creative hero + thumbnails by 8/15; Alex -> demo scripts + pre-record fallbacks by 8/25; Emily -> form + routing automation; Lee -> lock studio and recording logistics. I'll assemble the series doc and invite rehearsals.
alex: I'm good to demo toggles and will prepare a short fail-safe video.
sam: Will start creative and request headshots.
maria: Locking format and timeline unless objections by EOD. Series title draft: "Inference Fundamentals: Benchmarks, Fallbacks, & Optimization". If no objections, I'll spin up the landing page and shared doc. Thanks team! :rocket:
